summary: The frozen LATENT-001 contract evidences all DESIGN_GATE criteria. It specifies a source-only learned latent semantic decomposition, rejects prohibited substitutes such as PCA/clustering/coordinate naming as semantic identification, freezes target cases before training, and predeclares validity diagnostics, controls, risk accounting, bounds discipline, and decision thresholds. Implementation is not yet audited at this gate.

checks.criterion: 1. The SCM has independent task, relation, mean, covariance, and residual generating blocks in dimension greater than one.
checks.evidence: docs/experiments/LATENT-001_contract.md:26-35 declares independent standard Gaussian innovations with d_C=3, d_U=d_rel=d_mean=d_cov=3, d_noise=3, and equations for task Y/C, relation U/A_rel, mean A_mean, covariance A_cov, and residual N. Lines 37-40 state the input concatenates all five blocks.

checks.criterion: 2. Source factorial interventions cover two axes and reserve a third unseen axis; target cases are frozen before training.
checks.evidence: docs/experiments/LATENT-001_contract.md:37-40 specifies factorial source environments with signed interventions on axes 1 and 2 for relation, mean, and covariance, while axis 3 is absent from source intervention labels and reserved as unseen. Lines 42-50 list frozen target labels, including unseen_relation_axis3, and lines 52-53 prohibit target quantities from entering training, lambda selection, whitening, operator regression, residualization order, semantic naming, or budget selection.

checks.criterion: 3. The semantic estimator is source-only, cross-fitted, whitened on source support, and produces residualized projectors in a frozen hierarchy.
checks.evidence: docs/experiments/LATENT-001_contract.md:72-88 defines a source-only estimator: split source environments into A/B folds, whiten latent values on fold A source-mixture non-degenerate support, regress fold-A source environment moments on the signed factorial source design, residualize in frozen task-relation-mean-covariance order, use the support complement as residual, map projectors back for attribution, evaluate on fold B, then exchange folds and aggregate without target data.

checks.criterion: 4. Oracle recovery, intervention-label permutation, projection-order sensitivity, bottleneck collapse, and unseen-direction controls are present.
checks.evidence: docs/experiments/LATENT-001_contract.md:90-101 requires projector validity, cross-fit operator transfer, principal-angle recovery against known generating blocks, source intervention-label permutation, all legal semantic orders, seed/lambda stability, and bottleneck collapse/mixing diagnostics. Unseen-direction control is specified by reserving axis 3 from source labels at lines 37-40 and including unseen_relation_axis3 among frozen targets at lines 42-50.

checks.criterion: 5. Success/failure criteria and componentwise risk accounting are executable.
checks.evidence: docs/experiments/LATENT-001_contract.md:103-127 gives executable componentwise risk accounting with w_k=P_k w, main effects, pairwise interactions, Shapley-style equal interaction split, closure to evaluated risk gap, predeclared SCM-derived budgets, and NO OMEGA-TO-COMPONENT BOUND fallback absent an independently verified bridge. Lines 129-142 register executable success and failure rules: source-only lambda selection, operator decrease, at least 25% head-energy decrease, at least 25% covered-target improvement versus paired ERM, source-risk cost at most 10% of paired ERM target excess, 8-of-10 seed agreement, and enumerated failure labels.
